changelog: A fix for 0.168: the weight and grip libraries now live in d2rloader\d2r_vr_libs instead of the plugins folder, so D2RLoader no longer logs "2 plugins rejected" on every start. Setup removes the old copies. Everything else is as in 0.168: weapons with weight, a flail on a real chain, the bow's energy orbs and no more frozen game in native OpenXR.
